name: moe_router
summary: Mixture-of-Experts retrieval over the crystal chain. No training. Past inference records ARE the experts. Incoming prompts match by n-gram overlap; top-k matches surface their forward chains as priors for the next call.
engine_pattern: CrystalChainCursor extends ParserCursor — each crystal record is presented as NODE_ELEMENT name='record' with routing fields as attributes (queryable via has_attribute / get_named_attribute_value) and big text bodies on data.
indexing_strategy: At build_from(cursor) time, walk the chain once. For each record extract n-grams (2-grams + 3-grams, same algorithm as user_graph) from (original_prompt + enhanced_prompt + reasoning_trace + output_text). Map ngram_hash → list[crystal_id]. Genesis record is skipped.
retrieval_algorithm: 1) extract_ngrams(incoming_prompt). 2) for each gram hash, look up ngram_to_experts. 3) score each crystal_id by # of overlapping grams. 4) sort by (-score, crystal_id). 5) return top-k ExpertMatch with score, fit_ratio (score / total_incoming_grams), matched_ngrams, tier, model, scope, timestamp, forward_chain, original_prompt, snippets.
summarize_for_prompt: Renders top-k matches as PRIOR EXPERT FORWARD CHAINS block, dedupes by forward_chain[:200] prefix, caps at max_chars (default 1500). Returns empty string if no matched expert has a forward_chain.
non_overriding_principle: MoE retrieval does NOT change the deterministic token-bucket routing decision. It only enriches the prompt with prior expert forward chains. The router stays deterministic; smartness grows from the index size.
substrate: moe_index (in-memory, rebuilt from crystal_chain on each build_from)

inbound_callers: CLI: python3 moe_router.py find | walk | summary

guarantees: Deterministic — same crystal chain + same incoming prompt → same top-k matches in same order
Read-only — never writes to the crystal chain; safe to run concurrently with logger
Cross-substrate ngram compatibility — hashes match user_graph's, so user n-grams can be joined with model n-grams later
usage_example:
from moe_router import CrystalChainCursor, MoERouter
cur = CrystalChainCursor(); cur.open()
router = MoERouter.build_from(cur)
matches = router.find_experts('wire the forward projector', k=5)
for m in matches:
    print(m.score, m.tier, m.model, m.fit_ratio, m.forward_chain[:80])
